items.title: Taco Bell Works to Restore Sales Following Cyclospora Outbreak
items.summary: Taco Bell has consistently been one of the best-performing QSRs in the industry over the past several years. A U.S. public health crisis quickly interrupted that momentum. The chain’s same-store sales declined 2 percent quarter-to-date through July 27 after a cyclospora outbreak sickened thousands across several states. The sharpest impact came over the weekend of […]

items.title: Taco Bell sales fell after cyclospora outbreak
items.summary: Taco Bell’s parent company, Yum Brands, reported robust sales and profit in the second quarter. But more recent sales took a hit after the cyclospora outbreak plunged the company’s most important brand into a food-safety crisis.

items.title: Yum! Brands Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Taco Bell Strength
items.summary: YUM tops earnings estimates as Taco Bell's strong sales and global expansion help offset softer Pizza Hut performance.

items.title: Yum Brands' sales rose last quarter, thanks to Taco Bell
items.summary: The fast-food chain operator's system sales rose 5% last quarter as it works toward completing the sale of Pizza Hut.

items.title: Yum! Brands Q2 net income surges 128% to $853m
items.summary: In the latest quarter, the company’s total revenues rose 12% year-on-year to $2.16bn.

items.title: Taco Bell Has Plan to Bounce Back From Lettuce Crisis
items.summary: After a parasitic outbreak was linked to lettuce served at its restaurants, Taco Bell sales took a hit, it said in its earnings today. Now, it's using $1 Mexican Pizzas and limited-time offers like butter chicken tacos to entice people back.

items.title: Yum Brands Says It’s Moving Quickly to Address Cyclospora Outbreak
items.summary: Yum Brands said its teams are working quickly and transparently in response to one of the biggest food-safety crises in Taco Bell’s history, after public-health officials linked the shredded lettuce garnishing some of its menu items to a rapidly expanding cyclospora outbreak.
